fact: The Ministry of the Interior says the operation launched in 2010 aims to constitute the population database through the centralised national civil-status register (RNEC) and the NIN.
The Interior Ministry put the national automated civil-status register into service on 15 February 2014, holding about 59 million digitised birth acts collected from the databases of 1,541 communes.
system: Registre national automatisé de l'état civil

fact: The Interior Ministry says the Registre national de l'Etat civil is in use, with access to its data giving nearly 111 million consultations in 2023.
The Interior Ministry says 23 ministries and public bodies drew on Registre national de l'Etat civil data in 2023, nearly 111 million consultations.

At the Council of Ministers of 18 May 2025, after government examinations on 3 and 17 April, President Tebboune sent back the draft civil-status law, whose directives aim to create a unified national civil-status database accessible to all concerned administrations (La Voie d'Algérie).
